name: Matte Coral Slim Aluminum Seltzer Can
description: A tall, slim aluminum hard-seltzer can with a smooth matte powder-coat finish in deep coral, wrapped by a wide chalk-white band around the lower third with a hard, clean split edge, sealed with a bare brushed-aluminum pull-tab lid.
materials: Matte-finish powder-coated aluminum can body; bare brushed aluminum lid, rivet, and ring pull-tab.
primaryColors: Matte deep coral body with a wide chalk-white band around the lower third; bare silver aluminum lid.
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, wordmark, printing, or embossed lettering anywhere on the can; never add a label, sticker, or emblem; never widen the can into a squat standard format, and never swap the matte powder-coat for gloss or bare mill aluminum; never add a second band or change the chalk-white band's height or position; no props, hands, or presenter in frame; background stays a clean white or very light neutral studio backdrop with soft even lighting only. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the can's tall slim cylindrical proportions, matte deep-coral body color, and the chalk-white band's width and vertical position on the lower third identical and consistent across all four angles, with the split edge between coral and white always hard and perfectly horizontal; lid geometry (seamed rim, recessed dome, rivet, ring pull-tab) must match exactly between the front/three-quarter views and the cap-closure macro. When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
